name: civil3d-mcp
description: Dynamic Roslyn-based MCP server for Autodesk Civil 3D.

scripts.test:plugin: npm run build && dotnet run --project tests/plugin/Civil3dMcpPlugin.CoreTests.csproj --configuration Release && node --test tests/plugin/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:skills: npm run build && node --test tests/skills/*.test.mjs && dotnet run --project tests/skills/Civil3dMcp.SkillTests.csproj --configuration Release
scripts.test:transport: npm run build && node --test tests/transport/*.test.mjs && dotnet run --project tests/transport/Civil3dMcpPlugin.TransportTests.csproj --configuration Release
